name: Enhanciar
tagline: Ask your company brain from Cline, with a source link on every answer
description: Hosted company-brain MCP server. It answers questions from a team's Slack, Gmail, Notion, Drive, Jira, Linear and GitHub with a link to every source, and drafts tickets, replies or docs that wait for a person to approve them. Needs an Enhanciar API key (paid plans).
